Strategic, conscientious, slightly Type A, prefers structured planning. Warm with people, competitive streak, focused on self-improvement.
Diet: prioritizes high-protein and whole foods. Meal preps lunches to avoid unhealthy office snacking. Occasionally indulges during business dinners.
